Name: Inflate / Deflate
Description: Pushes terrain uphill toward local highs or downhill toward local lows using a directional morphological pass.

Sections.Name: Direction
Sections.Label: Direction
Sections.Description: Choose whether the local slope is pushed uphill or downhill.

Params.Name: Mode
Params.Label: Operation
Params.Description: Inflate expands local highs uphill; Deflate expands local lows downhill.

Params.Name: Radius
Params.Label: Push distance
Params.Description: Maximum distance sampled along the local slope in texels.

Sections.Name: Slope
Sections.Label: Slope gating
Sections.Description: Limit the operation to meaningful slopes.

Params.Name: SlopeLimit
Params.Label: Slope limit
Params.Description: Normalized slope below which the operation is suppressed.

Params.Name: SlopeSoftness
Params.Label: Slope softness
Params.Description: Smooth transition from no operation to full inflation or deflation.
